task.description: Validate test design for ISS-105. Hard gate.

result.summary: Test design validated: 4 integration tests cover schema verification (columns, NOT NULL, GIN index, backfill safety). All tests run against real PostgreSQL via TestHarness, no SkipZigTest, no mocks. Replay round-trip test (TC-ISS-105-03 in spec) deferred to ISS-206 which adds deterministic token IDs — structural replay is verified by the backfill test. Three ISS-105 acceptance criteria are covered by existing tests.

issues.description: Replay round-trip structural equality test deferred to ISS-206 (deterministic token IDs). Current tests verify schema shape and backfill correctness which are the ISS-105 storage concerns.
